data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. Please check the status of your API key in the 'API Keys' section of the Admin Console to ensure it has not expired or been accidentally revoked. If the key is valid but the API-AUTH-401.4 error persists, we recommend generating a brand new API key and updating your application configuration accordingly. [T-5246] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
